name: llm-skill-merchant
description: mux's personal cross-machine skill marketplace: role-scoped plugins for human-AI research collaboration.

plugins.name: human-ai-code-agent-kit
plugins.description: AI Code Agent side of the human-AI research collaboration model <suit-for-code-agent>: doc-contract-driven skills for experiment lifecycle (exp), evaluation (eval), compute operations (ops), and implementation workflow (impl).

plugins.name: human-ai-research-assistant-kit
plugins.description: AI Research Assistant side of the human-AI research collaboration model <suit-for-ai-research-assistant>: seven-mode kit for research discussion (sparring), research logs (incl. braindump-to-log protocol), decision notes, code-agent tasks, technical references, literature survey fan-out, and academic presentation writing.

plugins.name: slack-message
plugins.description: Slack message drafting <suit-for-ai-research-assistant>: audience-register-driven drafting (from-scratch and reply modes) with per-workspace SLACK-MESSAGE-TONE.md recipient profiles. /slack-message:tof exports to a file, /slack-message:cp copies to the clipboard. Drafting only — never sends.

plugins.name: agent-workspace
plugins.description: Per-task self-tracking convention <suit-for-ai-research-assistant> <suit-for-code-agent>: agent_workspace/{YYYY-M-D}-{topic}/ with worklog.md, STATUS.md, and HANDOFF.md, plus the create-or-continue rule and the write triggers that keep the three current instead of reconstructed at the end of a session.

plugins.name: magi
plugins.description: MAGI decision council <suit-for-ai-research-assistant>: one decidable proposition, a shared bound-facts pack, orthogonal lenses deliberating in parallel and blind, every reason audited back to source, a unanimous vote red-teamed before it stands, and a ruling reported as a tally with surviving reasons, costs of not acting, and flip conditions. /magi:ask convenes it. The human still decides.

plugins.name: multi-agent-discussion
plugins.description: Multi-Agent Discussion Protocol <suit-for-ai-research-assistant>: file-based structured debate between multiple AI agents and the human, converging into final.md under the human's arbitration.
